messages.menu.keyAmbiguous: Multiple menus or formats target the same location through key {key}. Review the keys; no ambiguous menu is rendered.
messages.menu.noKeysKnown: No installed template declares Menu keys. Use Mustache or declare the required keys; the menu can still be saved.
messages.menu.identityHelp: Stable key used by Mustache. Editing the name does not change it.

messages.menu.copyFailed: Copy was unavailable. Select and copy the displayed example.
